profile.summary: Soul Shoppe is a nonprofit that provides social-emotional learning programs for schools. Its interactive workshops teach students tools and language for managing emotions, mindfulness, communication and resolving conflicts. It offers both digital and on-site programs for individual students and whole school communities.
